We are hiring freshers for our Trainee Software Developer programme in Pune.

What you'll do
- Build REST APIs with Spring Boot under the guidance of senior engineers
- Write unit tests with JUnit

Requirements
- 0-1 years of experience (freshers welcome)
- Knowledge of Java and MySQL
- Any graduate (B.E/B.Tech/BCA/MCA) can apply

Training stipend of ₹15,000 per month during the 3-month training, followed by a CTC of 3.6 LPA.
